noun, first declension

machine; scaffold

  • scaffold

    the recommended word · classical · Digest 13.6.5.7 (Ulpian): a plasterer lent out falls dē māchinā; the risk differs if he was lent to work dē plānō, on the ground, or if the scaffold was minus dīligenter … ligāta or failed through fūnium perticārumque vetustāte; Vitruvius 7.2.2: māchinīs comparātīs (scaffolds set up for vaulting rooms); Vitruvius 10.1.1: scānsōriae māchinae, built tignīs statūtīs et trānsversāriīs conligātīs; M-O s.v. scaffolding
